blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Thirteen areas reached danger-level heat indices on Wednesday amid the effects of El Niño, the state weather bureau said. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), indices ranging between 42°C and 51°C are categorized “danger” level due to increased risks of getting heat cramps and heat exhaustion, which could then lead to heat stroke.
